sanskrit: na tvamevaṃ vicāroktyā yathoktaṃ śāsane mayā || 15 ||
śeṣānāṃ tu daśāṃśena japaṃ homaṃ tu kārayet || 33 ||
evaṃ vidhāṃ bhagavatīṃ vāgīśīṃ vāgprasiddhi māṃ || 42 ||
mantragrahaṇa kāle tu maṇḍalaṃ tatra kārayet || 46 ||
ariṇaṃ koṇabaṃdhaṃ tu pītaṃ vātha sitaṃ hitam || 55 ||
padmakṣetre tu sūtrāṇi diśi dikṣu vinikṣipet || 60 ||
caturthe tu dalāgrāṇi vyomakūṭaṃ ca pañcame || 63 ||
tīkṣṇāgraṃ tu yuvā tena kamalaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 68 ||
samantādaṣṭabhāgaṃ tu madhye tu kamalaṃ bhavet || 73 ||
kathitaṃ te samāsena tadbāhye vīthikā matā || 75 ||
daśa dikṣu tataḥ kāryaṃ pūrvavatkṛttikā sutaḥ || 76 ||
nair-ṛtyāṃ pītavarṇaṃ tu śuklaṃ varuṇadik sthitaṃ || 80 ||
īśāne mauktika prakhyaṃ śuklaṃ vā navapaṅkajaṃ || 81 ||
madhye padme śivaṃ pūjyo lokeśaścāpareṣu ca || 83 ||
dvipadaṃ kamalaṃ madhye vīthikā pathikā hitā || 87 ||
tatpṛṣṭe pathikā vīthī svastikā ca tadūrdhvataḥ || 89 ||
āpītaṃ pūrṇapadmaṃ tu vaiḍūryābhaṃ tu dakṣiṇam || 100 ||
